mapper.sql: sp.id AS plan_id, sp.plan_code, sp.plan_name, sp.billing_cycle_code, sp.price_amount, sp.currency_code, sp.is_active AS active, sp.sort_order, sp.description, sp.created_at, sp.updated_at

us.id AS subscription_id, us.user_id, us.plan_id, sp.plan_code, sp.plan_name, sp.billing_cycle_code, sp.price_amount, sp.currency_code, us.status_code, us.current_period_start, us.current_period_end, us.canceled_at, us.cancel_reason, us.created_at, us.updated_at

pt.id AS payment_id, pt.subscription_id, pt.user_id, pt.plan_id, pt.provider_code, pt.merchant_uid, pt.provider_payment_key, pt.status_code, pt.amount, pt.currency_code, pt.requested_at, pt.approved_at, pt.failed_at, pt.failure_code, pt.failure_message, pt.created_at, pt.updated_at

rt.id AS refund_id, rt.payment_id, rt.user_id, rt.provider_code, rt.provider_refund_key, rt.status_code, rt.refund_amount, rt.reason, rt.requested_by, rt.requested_at, rt.completed_at, rt.failure_code, rt.failure_message, rt.created_at, rt.updated_at
mapper.select: -- Count subscription plans. SELECT count(1) FROM subscription_plans sp

-- Select one subscription plan. SELECT
FROM subscription_plans sp WHERE sp.id = #{planId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert subscription plan. INSERT INTO subscription_plans ( id, plan_code, plan_name, billing_cycle_code, price_amount, currency_code, is_active, sort_order, description, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{planCode}, #{planName}, #{billingCycleCode}, #{priceAmount}, #{currencyCode}, #{active}, #{sortOrder}, #{description}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update subscription plan active status. UPDATE subscription_plans SET is_active = #{active}, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{planId}
mapper.select: -- Count user subscriptions. SELECT count(1) FROM user_subscriptions us INNER JOIN subscription_plans sp ON sp.id = us.plan_id

-- Select one user subscription with plan. SELECT
FROM user_subscriptions us INNER JOIN subscription_plans sp ON sp.id = us.plan_id WHERE us.id = #{subscriptionId}

-- Select current user subscription for duplicate mock payment prevention. SELECT
FROM user_subscriptions us INNER JOIN subscription_plans sp ON sp.id = us.plan_id WHERE us.user_id = #{userId} AND us.status_code IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE') ORDER BY CASE us.status_code WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 2 WHEN 'PAST_DUE' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END ASC, us.created_at DESC, us.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: -- Insert user subscription. INSERT INTO user_subscriptions ( id, user_id, plan_id, status_code, current_period_start, current_period_end, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{subscriptionId}, #{userId}, #{planId}, #{statusCode}, #{currentPeriodStart}, #{currentPeriodEnd}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update user subscription status. UPDATE user_subscriptions SET status_code = #{statusCode}, current_period_start = #{currentPeriodStart}, current_period_end = #{currentPeriodEnd}, canceled_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'CANCELED' THEN now() ELSE canceled_at END, cancel_reason = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'CANCELED' THEN #{cancelReason} ELSE cancel_reason END, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{subscriptionId}
mapper.select: -- Count payment transactions. SELECT count(1) FROM payment_transactions pt

-- Select one payment transaction. SELECT
FROM payment_transactions pt WHERE pt.id = #{paymentId}

-- Select payment transaction by merchant uid. SELECT
FROM payment_transactions pt WHERE pt.merchant_uid = #{merchantUid}
mapper.insert: -- Insert payment transaction request. INSERT INTO payment_transactions ( id, subscription_id, user_id, plan_id, provider_code, merchant_uid, status_code, amount, currency_code, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{userId}, #{planId}, #{providerCode}, #{merchantUid}, 'REQUESTED', #{amount}, #{currencyCode}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update payment transaction status. UPDATE payment_transactions SET status_code = #{statusCode}, provider_payment_key = COALESCE(#{providerPaymentKey}, provider_payment_key), approved_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'APPROVED' THEN now() ELSE approved_at END, failed_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELED') THEN now() ELSE failed_at END, failure_code = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELED') THEN #{failureCode} ELSE failure_code END, failure_message = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELED') THEN #{failureMessage} ELSE failure_message END, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{paymentId}
mapper.select: -- Count refund transactions. SELECT count(1) FROM refund_transactions rt

-- Select one refund transaction. SELECT
FROM refund_transactions rt WHERE rt.id = #{refundId}
-- Sum approved refund amount for a payment. SELECT COALESCE(sum(rt.refund_amount), 0) FROM refund_transactions rt WHERE rt.payment_id = #{paymentId} AND rt.status_code = 'APPROVED'
mapper.insert: -- Insert refund transaction request. INSERT INTO refund_transactions ( id, payment_id, user_id, provider_code, status_code, refund_amount, reason, requested_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{refundId}, #{paymentId}, #{userId}, #{providerCode}, 'REQUESTED', #{refundAmount}, #{reason}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update refund transaction status. UPDATE refund_transactions SET status_code = #{statusCode}, provider_refund_key = COALESCE(#{providerRefundKey}, provider_refund_key), completed_at = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} IN ('APPROVED', 'FAILED') THEN now() ELSE completed_at END, failure_code = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'FAILED' THEN #{failureCode} ELSE failure_code END, failure_message = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'FAILED' THEN #{failureMessage} ELSE failure_message END, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{refundId}
mapper.select: -- Select payment provider event by provider key. SELECT ppe.id AS event_id, ppe.provider_code, ppe.provider_event_id, ppe.event_type_code, ppe.payment_id, ppe.refund_id, ppe.result_code, ppe.received_at FROM payment_provider_events ppe WHERE ppe.provider_code = #{providerCode} AND ppe.provider_event_id = #{providerEventId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert non-sensitive payment provider event metadata. INSERT INTO payment_provider_events ( id, provider_code, provider_event_id, event_type_code, payment_id, refund_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{providerCode}, #{providerEventId}, #{eventTypeCode}, #{paymentId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{refundId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )

-- Insert non-PII billing audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
